central_selection_method.orientation: All dimension scores are 0–100 with higher=better. runtime_burden and adaptation_normalization_cost are inverted utility scores: a low burden/low surgery source scores higher.

score_equation.notation: For profile s with weights w_i and dimension scores d_i: G_s = 100 × exp(Σ_i w_i × ln(max(d_i/100, 0.01))); C = 0.5 + 0.5 × (evidence_confidence/100); m_s = min_i min(1, d_i/(gate_i+20)); DiamondScore_s = G_s × C × m_s when every hard gate passes, otherwise 0 with gate_status=BLOCKED.
score_equation.geometric_mean: Geometric mean prevents strong dimensions from fully hiding a weak dimension.
score_equation.min_sensitive_gate: m_s applies the weakest hard-gate dimension; any dimension below its hard threshold is fatal and returns BLOCKED/0, so fatal weakness cannot be averaged away.
score_equation.confidence_adjustment: Evidence confidence is both a scored dimension and a multiplicative confidence factor; missing evidence is not imputed.

dimensions.name: runtime burden

dimensions.name: evidence confidence

role_assignment.rule: Within each decision, role-specific profile and filter are applied first; the highest Diamond Score among eligible candidates wins that role. Ties break by evidence_confidence, then architecture_source_quality, then lower runtime burden. A source may be strong in one shape and ineligible in another.
role_assignment.user_facing_product_gate: A candidate can rank as a user-facing product surface only when source_class=product, its selected profile requires UI, gate_status=PASS, visual_ui_quality>=55 and evidence_confidence>=55. Old/poor UI can still score as engine_plus_owned_surface or pattern_reference, but never as a user-facing product surface.
role_assignment.engine_gate: For engine_plus_owned_surface, visual_ui_quality has zero weight and no UI gate; the owned Actionist surface is a separate deliverable.
role_assignment.missing_evidence: A missing hard-gate dimension or unresolved required evidence field yields score_status=UNDERDETERMINED and no rank; do not turn unknown into 50. In this packet, provisional scores expose open gates rather than claiming qualification.
